newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Material approves bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Material approves bonus issue.

text.p: Shareholders of Shanghai Material Trading Centre have approved a one-for-10 bonus issue based on the 1996 net, a company statement said on Tuesday.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended this morning and will resume this afternoon, the company statement in Tuesday's Shanghai Securities News said.
The company's net profit in 1996 was 11.035 million yuan based on domestic accounting standards, up 14.88 percent from 9.606 million yuan in 1995, a company annual report has said.
